newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY-BORDER DRAW WITH SOUTH EASTERN TRANSVAAL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY-BORDER DRAW WITH SOUTH EASTERN TRANSVAAL.

text.p: Border's chances of sneaking into the quarter finals of the Currie Cup were ended when they were held to a 20-20 (halftime 20-10) draw by South Eastern Transvaal in East London on Saturday.
Border - Tries: Andre Claasen, Craig Snelling. Conversions: Greg Miller (2). Penalties: Miller (2).
South Eastern Transvaal - Tries: Hakkies Swart, Johan Visagie. Conversions: Clive Terre'Blanche (2). Penalties: Terre'Blanche (2).
